description: SwiftUI view component for configuration settings interface, managing schema loading, section navigation, and form display.

classes.name: ConfigSettings
classes.description: Main SwiftUI view for configuration settings, handling schema display and user interactions.

classes.name: ConfigSection
classes.description: Represents a configuration section with key, label, help text, and schema node.

classes.name: ConfigSubsection
classes.description: Represents a subsection within a config section, including path and schema node.

classes.name: SubsectionSelection
classes.description: Enum for tracking selected subsection, either all or specific key.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes ConfigSettings with optional store parameter.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout with sidebar and detail views.

methods.name: ensureSelection
methods.description: Ensures a section and subsection are selected based on current schema.

methods.name: resolveSections
methods.description: Resolves and sorts configuration sections from schema.

methods.name: resolveSubsections
methods.description: Resolves and sorts subsections within a section.

methods.name: resolvedSchemaNode
methods.description: Resolves schema node variants, preferring non-null schemas.

methods.name: humanize
methods.description: Converts schema keys into human-readable labels.
